That is an enormous swing in a Level-3 estimate based on 'credible purchase offers,' which means MANAGEMENT'S 6/30/25 ESTIMATE WAS DEMONSTRABLY WRONG by a 9-figure dollar amount within one fiscal quarter. The disposition of the eBOS sub-business on Feb 20, 2026 for only ~$70M cash on assets carrying $192M (pre-impairment $391M) further bounds the misstatement.

rfm_tuples.interpretation: The Renewables segment was previously a featured 'long-term growth' story for ROCK with $185M of goodwill + $48M intangibles + $193M of trade-receivable/inventory/PPE — a $391M held-for-sale asset block at 12/31/24 that ROCK then proceeded to write down by $176M (45% of carrying) within 6 months of reclassifying it as held-for-sale at 6/30/25. SEVERE because the magnitude ($176M) is ~10% of pre-acquisition market cap and the Feb 2026 eBOS sale at $70M validates the writedown was if anything still optimistic vs market-clearing price.

summary: ROCK (Gibraltar Industries) is a profitable, well-audited (EY clean, ICOFR effective, NO_GOING_CONCERN, CLEAN_AUDITOR_TENURE) building-products manufacturer whose -50% drawdown is driven by TWO real but partly-obscured stressors that the 10-K narrative softens. (1) SEVERE — the Renewables divestiture booked $176M of impairment in H2 2025 against an asset that management had carried at 'fair value > carrying' just months earlier at the 6/30/25 held-for-sale reclassification; the Feb 20 2026 eBOS sale at ~$70M cash validates that the writedown was if anything still optimistic, demonstrating management's own Level-3 valuation was materially wrong within a single fiscal year. (2) MODERATE — the OmniMax acquisition (closed Feb 2 2026, $1.335B all-cash funded by new $1.3B senior secured term loans) transforms ROCK from a net-cash issuer with zero drawn debt into a 5.25x-leverage covenant-constrained issuer overnight; the 10-K's framing of OmniMax as 'our most profitable segment' technically reaffirms the deal logic but materially de-emphasizes the leverage cliff and the now-moot $200M buyback authorization (zero shares repurchased in FY25 vs $200M auth = MODERATE in its own right). Backlog +102%/Agtech +239%, auditor cleanliness, ICOFR effectiveness, insider passivity (only $2.2M in routine sales over 365d), and the post-close $482M revolver availability all PASS. The 29-facility manufacturing footprint claim is UNVERIFIABLE via EPA FRS because acquired-brand entity resolution is required (cf. AHC entity-resolution lesson). Composite 0.571 (4 PASS / 2 MOD / 1 SEV / 0 RED across 7 verifiable claims; 1 UNVERIFIABLE dropped). The Renewables impairment is the strongest honesty-alpha signal in the filing.
